In [[abstract algebra|algebra]], a commutative [[Noetherian ring]] ''A'' is said to have the '''approximation property''' with respect to an [[Ideal (ring theory)|ideal]] ''I'' if each finite system of polynomial equations with coefficients in ''A'' has a solution in ''A'' if and only if it has a solution in the [[completion (ring theory)|''I''-adic completion]] of ''A''.<ref name=rotthaus/><ref name=stacks/> The notion of the approximation property is due to [[Michael Artin]].

*[[Popescu's theorem]]
